sources.title: opus-mt-ja-en: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview opus-mt-ja-en is a Japanese-to-English neural machine translation model built by Helsinki-NLP using a transformer-align architecture trained on the OPUS dataset. The model uses normalization and SentencePiece preprocessing to handle the morphological complexity of Japanese before translation. It achieves a BLEU score of 41.7 and character F-score of 0.589 on the Tatoeba test set. You ...
